context:
Goal: every repo's CI is fast without a test-red main going unseen.
Problem (risk): joyous #87 drops Test, Build and Install on push to main. Your ruling 176 b (21:45 CST Nov 12) keeps non-macOS push suites until claude-settings changes the red-main check, so #87 is held. A skip that applies to every repo needs your word.
Based on (measured): 12 of 12 recent joyous merges pushed a tree equal to the PR's tested tree (runner 11 read).
Based on (ruling): 176 b; your rule that a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo; ci-once-per-batch (your 21:16 CST Nov 12).
Departs from: every repo runs its push suites on each push to main — a skips them when the pushed tree equals the tested tree.

options.gain: Push runs stop replaying tested trees in every repo.
options.how: A claude-settings lane adds the skip to the shared CI form: a push to main skips its suites when the pushed tree equals the tree the PR tested. Direct pushes still run them. joyous #87 then follows the shared form.
options.label: Put the tree-equal push skip in claude-settings' shared CI form, so every repo gets it (recommended)
options.lose: One claude-settings lane comes first; joyous waits for it.

options.how: Ruling 176 b stays as it is; joyous #87 stays held.
options.label: Keep all push suites until the red-main check changes
options.lose: Push minutes stay as they are in every repo.

options.gain: joyous gets the saving at once.
options.how: joyous skips on an equal tree by its own setting, outside the shared form.
options.label: Joyous-only skip (not recommended)
options.lose: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

reply: Your answer a was recorded at 12:11 CST against the OLD wording: the item then said 'Allow the tree-equal skip in joyous'. I rewrote it at 12:06 CST: a is now 'put the skip in claude-settings' shared CI form for every repo', and the joyous-only skip is option c, which goes against your rule that a repo changes to fit a shared tool. The page you answered from showed the old text. I have NOT acted on it. Please confirm: a (shared form, every repo), b (keep all push suites), or c (joyous-only).

shown.label: Put the tree-equal push skip in claude-settings' shared CI form, so every repo gets it (recommended)
Keep all push suites until the red-main check changes

title: Put the tree-equal push skip in the shared CI form for every repo, or keep all push suites?
why: A narrowing of your ruling 176 b needs your word; runner 11 waits on joyous only.
